caption: The drawing features multiple separate illustrations arranged on a single page, each bordered and labeled with text. In the top left, there is a plan view labeled "Plan of Ground including Parterre," showing a symmetrical garden layout with green grassy areas, light tan pathways, a central red building, and numerous scattered green circular trees. The paths curve organically, especially toward the lower part of the layout. To the right, there is a colored front elevation labeled "Front view of House," depicting a villa with red-tiled roofs, arched windows and doors, three chimneys, and two visible stories, surrounded by trees and greenery, including a large tree labeled "Prickly Acanthus" on the right. Below the villa, a vertical illustration shows a fountain with water spraying upwards and falling down, surrounded by green bushes, above a title block that reads "A Villa in the Italian style by A. J. Downing 1843," flanked by two large urns containing broad-leaved spiky plants, each urn placed on a green-and-pink pedestal. In the bottom left corner, there is an octagonal geometric design labeled "Parterre," with green, yellow, and red flower beds arranged in angular shapes around a central gray feature, bordered by a terrace marked in pale beige and outlined in red. The overall color palette consists of greens, light browns, reds, yellows, grays, and blues. All drawings are rendered in ink and watercolor. Shrubs and trees are shown as green blobs or detailed shapes, and ornamental urns and architectural details are illustrated with clear lines and pastel shading. Text in cursive and block print is used to label each component.
title: Italian Villa Design
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
